name: City Transport Simulator 2026: Season Pass
summary:
City Transport Simulator 2026 Season Pass enhances your gameplay by granting access to all upcoming content for the year, including an exclusive bonus vehicle only available through the Season Pass.

Expect a varied selection of new buses and iconic trams to enrich your fleet and diversify daily operations. The addition of a new Vienna map elevates realism, offering authentic bus and tram routes to navigate.

This Season Pass includes:

Exclusive Bonus: Citybus C2K for Season Pass owners
Bus DLC: Citybus C2
Tram DLC: Tatra KT4D
Vienna Bus & Tram Map DLC – featuring exclusive vehicles
Tram DLC: Flexity Graz
